story_description: As a developer, I need a Swift adapter that communicates with the Codex app-server via bidirectional stdio JSON-RPC so that Blaze can send prompts and receive streaming responses without HTTP transport.
task: Create CodexSandboxPolicyMapper for Blaze security mode translation
task_description: Create a mapper that converts Blaze security modes (Review, Trusted, Sandbox) to Codex sandboxPolicy and approvalPolicy JSON objects for use in turn/start requests.
atom: A001-CodexSandboxPolicyMapper Maps Blaze Security Modes to Codex Policies
atom_description: Implement CodexSandboxPolicyMapper struct with static methods to convert Blaze SecurityMode enum values to Codex-compatible sandboxPolicy and approvalPolicy JSON. Sandbox mode maps to readOnly type, Review mode maps to workspaceWrite type with writable project path and network access, Trusted mode maps to dangerFullAccess type. Approval policy maps Review mode to on-request and Trusted mode to never.
problem_statement: Blaze has a SecurityMode enum with three values (Review, Trusted, Sandbox) that govern file access and command approval. Codex uses different terminology with sandboxPolicy (readOnly, workspaceWrite, dangerFullAccess types) and approvalPolicy (on-request, never). Without a mapper, the CodexAdapter would need inline conversion logic that couples Blaze security concepts to Codex protocol details.
scope_in: Define CodexSandboxPolicyMapper struct with static mapping methods
Define CodexSandboxPolicy enum with readOnly, workspaceWrite, dangerFullAccess cases
Define CodexApprovalPolicy enum with onRequest, never cases
Implement toJSON methods for encoding policies as JSON-RPC params
Handle workspaceWrite case requiring projectPath parameter for writableRoots
scope_out: SecurityMode enum definition (already exists in Blaze core)
UI for security mode selection (handled by settings UI)
Runtime policy enforcement (handled by Codex server)
Gemini or Claude security mode mapping (separate adapters)
assumptions: Blaze SecurityMode enum exists with review, trusted, sandbox cases
Codex sandboxPolicy JSON must include type field
workspaceWrite requires writableRoots array and networkAccess boolean
approvalPolicy is a separate field from sandboxPolicy in turn/start params
Project path is available at mapping time for writableRoots
constraints: Must produce valid JSON compatible with Codex app-server expectations
Must be stateless - no side effects or stored state
Must be testable without running actual Codex process
Output must match CodexMonitor reference implementation exactly
Must use Codable for JSON serialization
functional_requirements: mapSandboxPolicy(from:projectPath:) returns CodexSandboxPolicy for given SecurityMode
mapApprovalPolicy(from:) returns CodexApprovalPolicy for given SecurityMode
CodexSandboxPolicy.toJSON() returns dictionary suitable for JSON-RPC params
Review SecurityMode produces workspaceWrite sandboxPolicy with provided projectPath in writableRoots and networkAccess true
Sandbox SecurityMode produces onRequest approvalPolicy (conservative default)
nonfunctional_requirements: Mapping operations are O(1) constant time
No heap allocations for simple enum cases
All types are Sendable for concurrent use
implementation_steps: Define CodexSandboxPolicyType enum with readOnly, workspaceWrite, dangerFullAccess cases
Define CodexSandboxPolicy struct with type and optional writableRoots and networkAccess properties
Define CodexApprovalPolicy enum with onRequest, never cases conforming to RawRepresentable with String
Implement CodexSandboxPolicy.init for each type with appropriate defaults
Implement static func mapSandboxPolicy(from mode: SecurityMode, projectPath: String) -> CodexSandboxPolicy
Implement static func mapApprovalPolicy(from mode: SecurityMode) -> CodexApprovalPolicy
Add switch statement mapping each SecurityMode case to appropriate policy
Write unit tests for each mapping combination
Verify JSON output matches CodexMonitor reference format
data_model_changes: New CodexSandboxPolicyType enum: readOnly, workspaceWrite, dangerFullAccess cases
New CodexSandboxPolicy struct: type, writableRoots, networkAccess properties
New CodexApprovalPolicy enum: onRequest, never cases
event_contracts: No events - this is a pure mapping utility
edge_cases: Empty projectPath string for workspaceWrite - use current directory as fallback
Unknown SecurityMode value if enum extended - default to most restrictive (sandbox)
nil projectPath when workspaceWrite required - throw descriptive error
failure_modes: Invalid projectPath could cause Codex to reject request - validated at call site
Mismatch between Blaze and Codex policy semantics - documented in code comments
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Engine/Codex/CodexSandboxPolicyMapper.swift and test file. Update any callers in CodexAdapter to use inline mapping temporarily. No database or persistent state affected.

notes: The mapping follows CodexMonitor reference implementation exactly. Key insight: Blaze Trusted mode equals Codex full-access equals dangerFullAccess sandboxPolicy plus never approvalPolicy. Blaze Review mode equals Codex default workspace mode.
